key.name: keep-firmware
key.description: Keep downloaded firmware files in the cache after a successful restore so they can be reused.

key.name: debug
key.description: Ask idevicerestore to print additional debug output.

key.name: ignore-errors
key.description: Try to continue the restore process after certain errors, like a failed baseband update.

key.name: keep-personalized
key.description: Write personalized components to files for debugging.

key.name: custom-firmware
key.description: Restore with a custom firmware. Requires a bootrom exploit.

key.name: signing-server
key.description: Overrides the default signing server request URL. Empty uses the default.

key.name: variant
key.description: Build identity variant to use. Empty selects it automatically.
